Just to give you all the glimpse of Ramoji Film City Hyderabad here are the top three Famous Attraction / Feature about this Flim City..


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-19 at 10.55.12 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23xpF8nM21xpTq7Sq3Ftvfc4hbuQK9ZGzizZMTmStvKoeqULuiTxmoeNT7TCFqu2NHKn8.jpeg)

### Dishi Gupta’s Movie Making Experience...

Lets us now talk a bit around the package that we bought it was an expensive one sine we didnt want to comporise on the experence and hence bought the - "HOLIDAY CARNIVAL STAR EXPERIENCE WEEKDAYS" package which costed us Rs.3600/- per person. https://youtu.be/sTWdDaKSvS8

Every time we look back at these pictures and watch the movie making video featuring our daughter, Dishi, it will bring back wonderful memories and remind us of a truly unforgettable family experience. # Hello Hive 

Happy new day to us all, I hope that Monday wasn't so harsh and that we feel refreshed enough to face a other day.  On a Tuesday like this we would be planting some corn at the farm today. I will be joining a neighbor to plant some corn seeds in her farm today. 

![1000214333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xKzYggJbbgWKg1fHgMghCb3FC2U7abDYKHrtSMmHk3175dfckovHBwEmEhq38i4qcBa.jpg)





This year has been a bit challenging for us regarding this work and a lot of people are begining to leave cultivation of the land out of their schedule to continue with planting exercise directly.

![1000214324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wqq1bos7BDPW8S4vyHU5unHJqYGBRcusNmkMzJnfudUm51mhWxRxUtj8eTxJDcgVWYU.jpg)


We weren't able to get labourers that will till the ground. It is an exercise we normally do yearly before planting. As soon as the rains begin, we clear out the land of previous year debir and then get labourers to till the ground preparing the ridges on which the crops will be planting.


![1000214312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23tmUAQXsCwSMV4eKzmt4YhuKjoDFFDzNgQioFYZHKrxcQKD5EmeyQ6GtPxdDyNk63afu.jpg)

![1000214327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wX3ncWM8JbLz9mZStVnXkWESQYq8R67VGjVkMCr8jbcR3NZkRjVveqP4kRzGCQj1yzp.jpg)


Over the years a lot of people especially the younger generation are shying away from doing any farm work, everyone wants a white collar job or some other types of skiled labour rather than farming, hence it is completely difficult to get labourers to till the ground for us now so that we can plant our crops.

Looking at the turnout of things many people are begining to adopt this metbod, they just plant their crops directly into the ground without first tilling the ground. 


![1000214312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23tmUAQXsCwSMV4eKzmt4YhuKjoDFFDzNgQioFYZHKrxcQKD5EmeyQ6GtPxdDyNk63afu.jpg)



Herbicides are sprayed into the ground to kill the weeds then with the aid of a hoe we plant the crops 



![1000214318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eo6NJxA6b9Nc7wRajZeiK9r582QTD4Z7q4TQXZiojeyuKvL4VXMQ6cLDEMm94EzNYL5.jpg)

Herbicides has been applied to the field and you can see how much the grasses have all burnt out now. The corn has been planted directly into the ground and while we were waiting for them to germinate, some have been picked up and eating by birds already.



![1000214342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23tmSbFgycrxqy4HygFNHaTuREBdms9udhvsuhjRCq7GpiyYwhmofRTP85mTPoVDg5xki.jpg)

A larger portion of the crops didn't germinate prompting us to plant a scarecrow in the field. 
Since majority of the corn didn't germinate, they will be replanted again today. Hopefully we won't have any challenges growing crops this way.

Saludos queridos amigos de encuentro de talentos, hoy martes disfrutando de unas largas vacaciones por España junto a dos de mis tres hijos y con el corazón alegre y dividido. Uno nunca sabe a donde nos llevaran nuestras pisadas y las marcas que vamos dejando en nuestro andar. a veces dejamos un poco de nuestro talento en nuestras palabras y otro poco de enseñanzas. Sin duda alguna un tema que nos toca a todos de diferentes maneras y formas. Creo que muchas veces desaprovechamos los cambios, porque nos sentimos sacados de nuestro entorno acostumbrados a una rutina y a mi me pega un poco. Pero siempre trato de buscar el lado positivo y la enseñanza de esos cambios. Les comparto el enlace del tema de esta semana que la amiga @angelica7 en el espacio [Encuentro de Talentos: "El futuro es un misterios"](https://hive.blog/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-el-futuro-es-un-misterios) nos ha aportado, están invitados a reflexionar, disfrutar y traernos claridad sobre el futuro y sus cambios a veces inesperados. Yo debo aprender a mirar más con los ojos de los hijos, ellos ven distintos a los míos y eso no lo sabía, tienen otra visión, otros cambios, pero sin perder mi propio estilo debe a veces dejarme guiar por ellos. Mi viaje estaba planeado hace tiempo y se había ido retrasando, sabía que cuando pisara al otro lado del charco mis hábitos cambiarían era un futuro esperado, podría caminar con más seguridad y menos peligro, podría visitar lugares nuevos y lugares por recorrer. Esta semana mi hija me enseño que repetir un lugar no significa volver atrás y perder el tiempo, significa que hay un cambio y debemos observarlo.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdTp8t76bwzyx1quvoR81eKmWA5o24CTrHNoaieU88T45/imagen.png)
No quería entrar otra vez al museo de la casa natal de Cervantes, ya lo había visitado hace cuatro años atrás, lo que no sabía era que había realizado algunos cambios colocando nuevos elementos como la ropa de la época, el vestuario. Y eso debo reconocerlo se volvió un aprendizaje a futuro, escuchar más a mi hija en lo que tiene que enseñarme. Voy dejando marcas y aprendizajes con mis palabras y también con mis huellas.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmch5WmwSQudvcanEaHdnmdqs2yVAR4GCca6xDGkxhci3M/imagen.png)
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSNE2R4UDvEP1t7uhLpLhaycAdshX7fzfWo8Gf4hxhW2i/imagen.png)
El futuro parece ahora más cercano, parece que se enlaza directamente con cada paso que damos. Los cambios que parecen hacernos temer el futuro, se vuelven más claros y nos van dando a conocer parte de nuestro objetivos en la vida, simplemente vivir y compartir de lo aprendido. Nuestra amiga @angelica7 no los pregunta también en su espacio personal [La pregunta](https://hive.blog/hive-147010/@angelica7/la-pregunta-mpbztbop-ati1eh) que nos inquieta a todos. ¿Estamos logrando algo al salir de nuestro espacio rutinario? ¿Tenemos miedo que nos paraliza y detiene? ¿Qué estamos aprendiendo de nuestros pasos a futuro? Nos unimos al tema sabiendo que no hay respuestas correctas, solo procesos que estamos pasando, aprendiendo, compartiendo cada día.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW8wHzSpWcvPRnchxh5AZF2okq3uSSHiXSoHqybnrxdhf/imagen.png)
Cada viaje aunque con temor se vuelve un nuevo aprendizaje, un nuevo espacio donde vamos dejando huellas de lo aprendido y compartido. Nadie dijo que fuera fácil como dije al principio tengo el corazón dividido cuando estoy en Venezuela por los que están en España y ahora que estoy en España sufro por los que deje en Venezuela. Trato de compartirle que estoy bien disfrutando de un espacio protegido, pero no sé que pensaran allá. La verdad voy a dejar de pensar y disfrutar de mis pasos, de hacer lo mejor posible por sentirme bien y cuidar de mi primero y de mi familia también.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZmiyZXUfL7aoigEQRbHDYGPxvcmXzXjuDnUNjMDF34TU/imagen.png)
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXjdQj14fwcsWqvChzMNnANC3qJhxGvLxHvczv4sjExxA/imagen.png)
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ3UpsfoqZzLKyfZWnd5qNUPGHgLvYwMkuZCascpRLM7h/imagen.png)
He disfrutado de espacios que deseaba tener cerca, de comidas que no podía acceder porque con lo que se compra sushi en Venezuela compro mejor un pollo para preparar y me dura más días. Así pensamos las amas de casa, siempre buscando la economía. Pero al igual que haya todo tiene un costo y se trabajo mucho y se paga bastante, pero hay un poco más se seguridad en tu entorno.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQhjheRdWNVhGPS2XSsoYf6z1QPgRTPCi2sytqnoW9anF/imagen.png)
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmddp3eMRFci7sB5SgfwgYvhAhYSDMaxk7fnU1HP4fmMBa/imagen.png)
También encuentro flores en mi entorno y belleza en las piedras, voy pisando el futuro sin saberlo que se vuelve mi pasado otra vez. Debo disfrutar aunque sufra por los otros, debo saber que hay limites para algunos, pero no una madre. Acabamos de ver a una madre en Venezuela darlo todo por encontrar a su hijo y así somos, hasta entregar la vida por ellos.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR468Nmx2e3ZhHoc6oVm3F3kjymapvjHD13zanSb7yV2N/imagen.png)
Un homenaje a las madres que también nos van dejando huellas en nuestro futuro, en cada día que se levantan a preparar el desayuno y a llevarnos a la escuela, esas pisadas van marcando también nuestro futuro. Son el diamante perfecto que se esta formando dentro de ti, que eres una roca imperfecta puliéndose cada día, desde adentro. Sé feliz y cuida tus huellas. Dejó huellas al escribir y compartir imágenes de los lugares recorridos. Hace frío, pero ya vendrá en calor con sus nuevos colores.

昨天五点半下班，赶着开车去接孩子。因为办公室刚换了地方，我的停车位也挪到了现在办公楼楼下。
 
这条路两边都停满了车，中间只留出窄窄一条通行过道，平日里不管是倒车入库还是开车驶出，都得格外小心翼翼。
 
原本还对自己的车技挺有信心，正常开车往外走时，一边盯着前方生怕碰到对面车辆，一边时不时瞟右后视镜，刻意和旁边车子拉开距离。可车身越往外开，间距越变越窄，或许是自己车速没把控好，还没等我反应过来，只听“擦”的一声，径直刮蹭到了旁边停着的宝马车。
 
路边站着几个人全程都看在眼里，立马拿出手机拍照，估计是怕我逃避责任。为了不堵塞过道、影响其他车辆通行，我先把车慢慢倒回停车位，随即下车查看刮蹭情况。
 
这时旁边一位男生已经拿出手机准备联系车主，我连忙上前诚恳道歉，才知道他们几个人和车主都是熟人。我赶紧先给飞哥打了电话，让他帮忙去接孩子，也跟他说了我不小心刮到别人车子的事。
 
以往偶尔有小刮小蹭，都是飞哥帮忙处理，划痕范围很小，补漆也就一百多两百块就能解决。但宝马维修费用肯定不低，飞哥当即让我走保险流程处理。
 
没过多久，车主赶了过来，是一位年轻帅气的男生。我不停跟他道歉，没想到他特别随和大度，一点都没有为难的意思。我们本就是公司同事，大家都互相体谅。他仔细看了下刮蹭位置，说只是轻微一点痕迹无伤大雅，还坦言上次他爱人停在这个车位，也同样刮到过别人的车。还感慨这个车位本身预留空隙就太窄，对面再有车辆停放的情况下，根本不好出库，需要借位慢慢挪才行。
 
我从来没自己报过车险，他还耐心教我拨打人保官方客服电话，一步步跟着语音提示操作。全程没有人工接听，只需报备两辆车的车牌号、事故具体地址就行。之后很快收到了人保理赔经理的联系方式，我拨通电话对接，按要求提交双方证件照片等资料，流程很快就办好，后续维修事宜全部交由保险公司对接处理。整件事从发生到现场办结，前后花了半个小时。
 
经历这件事也算是给我上了一课：永远不能心急赶路，更不能高估自己。行车如此，生活亦是如此，稳稳当当，小心驶得万年船。

A few years back, during the days of my internship, I observed something happen that taught me a very vital lesson. There was this employee who constantly rejected advices from the supervisor. She thought that she had known everything and that she was more qualified. Actually, she was taken in with her Master's Degree, but the supervisor only had Bachelor's Degree. This made her to feel that she was more superior and more qualified, not considering the fact that the supervisor had stayed long in the organisation and had gotten relative experience. Well, this thing kept happening. When it was time for promotion, she was overlooked despite her qualifications and skills. It was simply her uncontrolled ego that limited her opportunities. This is why you need to put ego in check.
![pexels-pavel-danilyuk-8638023.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdbwspmJtRwxGq9cT9hHUBisHRF4uGiiYeC2quFxPSqP2/pexels-pavel-danilyuk-8638023.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-woman-in-red-long-sleeve-shirt-8638023)
One of the things that I have observed is that ego is not always obvious. Sometimes it can come in form of pride, stubbornness, excessive feeling of self-importance, or the constant feeling to prove yourself right. It is true that confidence is healthy, but what is bad is uncontrolled ego, which can destroy relationships, opportunities, and limit growth. You will be surprised how lots of people lose valuable opportunities and chances in life, not because they lack talent, nor because they are not intelligent, but simply because their overinflated ego prevented them from listening, learning, and growing. It is uncontrolled ego that makes someone to think that they have known everything that needs to be known. When someone feels too proud to take corrections or to accept advice, their growth will become affected negatively. It does not matter how educated, skilled, talented, or learned someone may be, the truth remains that there are still lots of new things that they need to learn. But ego can actually close the mind of the person and create a resistance to improvement. This is because it takes humility and meekness to be able to accept that you do not know as much as you should and to learn more. One of the dangers of ego is that it damages relationships. People who have uncontrolled ego find it difficult to admit to their mistake, or to apologise, rather they will always seek justification for it or blame someone else for it. They do not even treat people rightly. They always seek superiority, attention, validation, and feel like the main character. Over time, this attitude will begin to drive people from them. You have to understand that good relationships are not built on pride nor on ego, but on respect, humility, and understanding. You need humility to be able to treat people with respect that they deserve. Ego does not only affect opportunities in personal life, it also affects them in professional life. The truth is that teachers, mentors, employers, and even leaders will value you more when you are teachable and not arrogant. Someone who often refuses guidance, or often acts like they are above learning will constantly lose valuable opportunities for growth and advancements. After all, you cannot add more water to a cup that is already full of water. In the same way, if you see yourself as knowing all, it will limit you from learning more. More often than not, talents and skills may open the door, but it is your character and your attitude that will determine if the door will be kept open.
![pexels-olly-3775130 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUYx5GkVMLE7UgbXmWAYEGc7CSpwaXDrmKJBMdNRvbEFY/pexels-olly-3775130%20(1).jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/elderly-man-in-a-sharp-contortion-face-3775130)
Uncontrolled ego can also becloud people from seeing their weaknesses. You need self-awareness to be able to grow, but you will need humility to be able to give yourself the honest review that you need. The moment you believe that you are always right, you will stop improving. At that point, you will ignore feedback, repeat the same mistakes, and may even be stuck in the same unhealthy pattern. But if you are humble, you will learn more, and you will keep growing. It is worthy to note that controlling your ego does not mean losing your confidence. You can still believe in yourself without looking down on someone else. Having a healthy confidence actually allows you to grow while also respecting others. But you should not allow it to degenerate into uncontrolled ego by feeling that you are better than everyone else. ***Thanks for reading***

I haven't been keeping up with the #biblejournal posts lately, but it's not because I'm not reading 1 and 2 Corinthians.  In fact, I'm well into the second book now but have just had other stuff to post these past few days.

Again, while not on a schedule per se, I will be posting these journaling journeys throughout the week.  And as always, I truly do hope these are a blessing to you as you go through them with me.

Let's dive into **Chapter 7 of 1 Corinthians**...

The bulk of the first part of this chapter is all about the marriage union.  How important is this to God?  If you look back to the creation account in Genesis, God created two institutions before sin ever entered into the garden of Eden.  There was Sabbath on the seventh day and then...Marriage.

So wives and husbands are a big deal to God, and we see Paul go over quite a bit here.  I highlighted verse 4, but if you read this without context, you might get a wee bit upset...

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR59oSLTAxnqYYzbiMNsZwcfS7axR9zuJVVamxjhtxVYh/IMG_8878.jpeg 

And if you see the highlight that I wrote down about the big picture for me in 1 Corinthians 7 is that, marriage is a team.  Wives belong to their husbands, and husbands belong to their wives.  But they both belong and are to worship, their Creator.  

God made marriage to be the ultimate team sport.  Two become one flesh, so this isn't just a title but a lifetime commitment to each other.

Sadly, we see marriage become something of an after thought in today's society and the destruction of traditional marriages and families are truly, the work of Satan. 

This chapter is one of the longer ones in this book and it goes over a lot.  I did highlight a few more verses that I'll go over...

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTvApFSi57tU3mPL8KCko8QAvnUZkfPCt1qmQKuqWvtYc/1-CORINTHIANS-7-19-KJV-Circumcision-is-nothing-and-uncircumcision-is-nothing-but-the-keeping-of-the-commandments-of-God--05-18-2026_09_57_PM.png 

This verse stuck out to me, mostly because of a study I did a few weeks ago on it.  There is a popular thought within Christianity that the commandments of God have been done away with.  Here we see the massive deal Paul makes about circumcision both here and other places throughout the New Testament.

If circumcision is something (*or nothing*) and is mentioned this much....I'd think the commandments that God wrote with His own finger would be a bigger deal if they were abolished.  But here we see the clear statement by Paul himself....What matters is keeping the commandments of God.

There's much more detail that confirms this, but this wasn't the big takeaway for me in this chapter.

**It still came down to marriage!**

And how important it is to God.  We aren't to 'control' each other, but to love each other.  It's a union between two people but more importantly, it's a promise to God who instituted marriage at the beginning of the world.

I think that's a beautiful thing!
